purpose: Per-phase benchmark gates from the API DX improvement plan (section 7 workflow)
method: scripts/api_benchmark.py --samples 10 --warmup 2 against 127.0.0.1 working DB; phase-scoped metrics below

phase_0_baseline.verdict: baseline recorded before code changes; values are p50/p95 from scripts/api_benchmark.py --samples 10

phase_1_gate.verdict: compact <= 2.5 KB; coverage ETag-cached and served from refreshed MV

phase_2_gate.verdict: consistency and reach checks passed; no payload regression on list endpoints

phase_3_gate.verdict: compact list under 75 KiB; rate-limit and total=false additive params verified

note: Phase 1-3 metrics were captured during the final verification pass on the cumulative implementation; the baseline file records the pre-change state.
